async def work(items):
    for item in items:
        async def callback(value=item):
            await read(value)
        callbacks.append(callback)
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await read(item)
        async def nested(value=item):
            for child in value.children:
                # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
                await read(child)
        callbacks.append(nested)
